mapper.sql: s.id, s.school_code AS schoolCode, s.school_name AS schoolName, s.district_code AS districtCode, s.address, s.contact_phone AS contactPhone, s.status, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM school s WHERE s.id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY s.school_name, s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE school SET school_name = #{schoolName}, district_code = #{districtCode}, address = #{address}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: u.id, u.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.mobile, u.enabled, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user u JOIN school s ON s.id = u.school_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE u.school_id = #{schoolId} AND r.role_code = 'SCHOOL_ADMIN' ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id
SELECT FROM sys_user u JOIN school s ON s.id = u.school_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE u.school_id = #{schoolId} AND u.username = #{username} AND r.role_code = 'SCHOOL_ADMIN'
SELECT FROM sys_user u JOIN school s ON s.id = u.school_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE u.school_id = #{schoolId} AND u.id = #{id} AND r.role_code = 'SCHOOL_ADMIN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( school_id, role_id, username, password_hash, display_name, mobile, enabled ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, (SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = 'SCHOOL_ADMIN' AND enabled = TRUE), #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{mobile}, #{enabled} )
mapper.sql: c.id, c.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, c.class_name AS className, c.grade, c.school_year AS schoolYear, c.status, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM school_class c JOIN school s ON s.id = c.school_id WHERE c.school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY c.school_year DESC, c.grade, c.class_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO school_class (school_id, class_name, grade, school_year, status) VALUES (#{schoolId}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{schoolYear}, #{status})
